description_en: Large parts of the temple date back to the mid-17th century. A stone inscription attests to the temple's construction in 1662 CE, however, some of the inscriptions on the struts mention a date four years prior (1658 CE). According to an inscription embedded in the courtyard wall, a new statue of Gaṇeśa was installed in 1787 CE. Sāhīs (Khaḍgīs) and Śreṣṭhas of Tāpāhiti Ṭola worship Gaṇeśa at this local temple.The upper roof is covered with gilt copper sheets and topped by a gilt pinnacle and parasol. The lower roof is covered withjhĩgaṭitiles and both roofs are supported by carved struts depicting images of Gaṇeśa, Bhairava and the eight mother goddesses. A repoussétoraṇawith Gaṇeśa in the centre can be found at the entrance, as well as an aniconic stone worshipped as Kumāra. A stone statue of Gaṇeśa resides in the centre of the sanctum, next to a small shrine with a statue of Sarasvatī next to it.An aniconic stone in the centre of the small courtyard in front of the temple is worshipped as Bhairava. Artefacts mentioned inPruscha(1975, P-84) such as Śītalā, Tārā, Kailāśa and astūpacould not be found.No priest is appointed to this temple. Local people usually visit the temple in the morning to worship Gaṇeśa before attending special functions such as rituals of initiation, marriage, andbhīmarathārohaṇa.The temple was severely damaged in the 2015 earthquakes but surprisingly did not collapse. Haphazardly placed timber braces have supported the temple for the past five years. According to local informants, it has not yet been possible to raise the necessary funds for its restoration. Smaller repairs have been carried out over the last few years, such as the installation of new cement-plastered shrines in the sanctum and the decorative cement plaster coverings of the ground floor walls. The poorly maintained roofs are causing severe water damage to the timber structure, so that the temple is at a risk of collapsing.
description_ne: यो मन्दिर तापाहिति टोलमा रहेका साही (खड्गी) र श्रेष्ठहरूको थान गणेश हो । दक्षिणाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको यो मन्दिरमा दुई तहको छाना रहेको छ । मन्दिरको माथिल्लो छानामा तामाको पाता राखी सुनको जलप लगाइएको छ । छानामाथि सुनको जलप लगाइएको गजूर राखी छत्र ओढाइएको छ । मन्दिरको तल्लो छानामा झिँगटीको राखिएको छ । दुईवटै छानाको बोझ थाम्न कलात्मक टुँडाल राखिएका छन् । टुँडालमा गणेश, भैरव लगायत अष्टमातृका अंकित गरिएका छन् । मन्दिरको भुइँतलामा गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकामाथि गणेश अंकित पित्तलको पाताले मोडिएको तोरण राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र दक्षिणाभिमुख गरी गणेशको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र कुमारको प्रतीक स्वरूप आकृतिविहीन शिला, अर्को गणेश मूर्ति र सरस्वतीको मूर्ति पनि स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिर प्राङ्गणमा भैरवको प्रतीक स्वरूप आकृतिविहीन शिला स्थापना गरिएको छ ।Pruscha(1975, P-84) ले उल्लेख गरेका शीलता, तारा, कैलाश, स्तूप जस्ता कलाकृतिहरू अहिले देखिँदैनन् ।यो मन्दिर नेसं ७८२ मा चतुर्दशी गुठीका मानिसहरू मिलेर बनाइएको थियो । तर मन्दिरको टुँडालमा कुँदिएको अभिलेखमा नेसं ७७८ अंकित गरिएको छ । यसबाट मन्दिर बन्नुभन्दा अघि नै टुँडाल तयार गरिएको देखिन्छ । नेसं ९०७ मा गणेशको पुरानो मूर्ति भग्न भएकोले नयाँ मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको थियो । विसं १९९० को भूकम्पले नभत्केको यो मन्दिरलाई विसं २०७२ सालको भूकम्पले क्षति पुर्‍याएको थियो । मन्दिर भत्कन लागेकोले अहिले टेको राखिएको छ ।यस मन्दिरमा कुनै पूजारी नियुक्त गरिएको छैन । स्थानीयहरू बिहान उठेर पूजाआजा गर्ने क्रममा यस मन्दिरमा पनि पूजा गर्छन् । यो मन्दिर तापाहिति टोलको थान गणेश भएकोले टोलमा कसैको व्रतबन्ध, विवाह वा भीमरथारोहण जस्ता शुभकार्य गर्नुपर्दा सबभन्दा पहिले यसै मन्दिरमा आएर पूजा गर्नुपर्ने परम्परा छ ।

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a new Gaṇeśa statue
historical_events.event_description: Kṛṣṇasiṃha Bhāro, the grandson of Sāhiju donated a new Gaṇeśa statue. The old Gaṇeśa statue was badly damaged.

Inscriptions on two struts supporting the lower roof mention that Pañcamrani Maiyā and Virapati donated the struts in 1658 CE (NS 778).This was four years before the construction of the temple in 1652 CE (NS 782).
The temple was severely damaged by the 2015 earthquakes and is at the verge of collapse. Locals are working together trying to protect the temple and finding funding to restore it.
Members of Caturdaśī Sevā Guṭhī constructed the temple.
